stateTooltip.description: The client's connection state (healthy, unstable, needs re-authorization, and so on). "Unstable" reflects Bifrost's own connection checks to the server, not the results of tool calls made through it: it self-heals and never blocks tool calls. For per-user clients (OAuth, headers, token exchange), this reflects Bifrost's own retained admin credential (used only to periodically refresh the tool list), not any individual user's own session, which is unaffected either way.

nodeStates.disagree: Instances disagree about this client's state:

description.pendingTokenExchange: This server needs a one-time verification: Bifrost exchanges your signed-in identity token, tests the connection, and discovers tools. Callers then have their own identity tokens exchanged automatically on every tool call.
description.pendingPerUserOauth: This client was declared in config.json. An admin sign-in is needed to verify the OAuth setup and discover tools; Bifrost keeps it on file to refresh the tool list periodically. Each user will still authenticate individually when they use this server.
description.pendingOauth: This client was declared in config.json and needs a one-time OAuth authorization before it can be used.
description.needsReauthPerUser: The admin credential Bifrost keeps on file to refresh this server's tool list needs repair. End-user credentials and tool calls are unaffected. Use Refresh admin credential from the server's actions menu to fix it.
description.needsReauth: This connection's credentials need to be re-authorized. Use Reauthorize from the server's actions menu to redo the OAuth consent flow.

tooltips.name: Use a descriptive, meaningful name that clearly identifies the server. For example, use "google_drive" instead of "gdrive", or "hacker_news" instead of "hn". This name is used as the Python module name in code mode.
tooltips.ping: Enable to use lightweight ping method for health checks. Disable if your MCP server doesn't support ping - will use listTools instead.
tooltips.persistentConnection: Enable to keep one shared connection open and reused across every caller. Disable to connect fresh on every call instead.
tooltips.syncInterval: Override the global tool sync interval for this server. Leave empty to use global setting. Set to -1 to disable sync for this server.
tooltips.executionTimeout: Override the global tool execution timeout for this server. Leave empty or set to 0 to use the global setting.
tooltips.disableClient: When enabled, the client's connection, health monitor, and tool syncer are shut down. Tools from this client will not be available for inference until it is re-enabled.
tooltips.allowAllVirtualKeys: When enabled, this MCP server is accessible to all virtual keys without requiring explicit per-key assignment. All tools are allowed by default. If a virtual key has an explicit MCP config for this server, that config takes precedence and overrides this behaviour.

warnings.stickinessOpen: Toggling this takes effect immediately on save: the shared connection will be opened now.
warnings.stickinessClose: Toggling this takes effect immediately on save: the existing shared connection will be closed now.
warnings.oauthDisabled: OAuth config cannot be rotated while the client is disabled. Re-enable the client to update it.
warnings.oauthRotation: Changing any OAuth config field immediately signs out every current session on this MCP client, shared and per-user alike. Everyone will need to re-authenticate.
warnings.tokenExchangeEviction: Changing any token exchange field immediately evicts every cached exchanged token for this server. The next tool call for each caller re-exchanges a fresh token.
